name: Renderer QA: minimal
_note: Level 0 of the progressive matrix, and the scene the reference renderer is compared against: opaque geometry, one camera, nothing else. Everything absent here is absent on purpose -- no transparency, no skinning, no particles, no water, no terrain, no sky. A difference between two renderers on this scene cannot be blamed on a subsystem, because there is only one.
